component: Batched sampled spec-verify target laws (MLX2_SPEC_BATCHED_SAMPLED_LAWS, default on)

pull_requests.title: [Perf] reject_sampling: Vocabulary-tiled final-token pass at small batch
radix top-k for speculative verify target probabilities

sources.use: Concept only, from the PR descriptions: sampled verification should not pay serial per-row host work at small batch. No code, kernel or test was copied.

sources.modifications: With the switch on, chain verify (_verify) and the AST progressive stage loop build every sampled, processor-free lane's per-row transformed log-probs lazily, stack them, and take one exp + one host copy per round instead of an eval + np.asarray per row. Greedy, processor, point-mass and ineligible rows keep the row-wise _target_law. probability() still validates every row; a non-finite row fails only its own lane (LaneFailure). A transform error drops that entry to the row-wise path; an eval error falls the whole round back. RNG draw order is unchanged. The tree path already batched its laws and is not touched. Opt-in at first; made default on on 2026-11-12 (Pierre).

validation.cpu_tests: tests/test_spec_batched_sampled_laws_cpu.py 22 passed (bit, RNG, response-row and lane-failure identity vs row-wise; flag-off never enters the batched builder); impacted external-draft/AST/env-switch/grid suites green with the switch off; default-on flip (2026-11-12): fault-injection tests that hook _target_law now also hook _batched_sampled_laws and run with the switch at 1 and 0; the impacted CPU set (~5,480 tests) is green both ways

gpu_ab.dataset: GSM8K fixed prompts (benchmarks/gsm8k), 100 questions, T 0.6 top_p 0.95 top_k 20 seed 1112, B1, max-lanes 1, port 18311, not thermally gated (not publishable perf)
gpu_ab.chain7: off vs on: 100/100 identical predictions, completion tokens and per-question accept histograms; accuracy 0.51 both; mean acceptance length 5.147 both, per-position p1..p7 .840/.753/.657/.575/.505/.441/.375 both; counters on: external_batched_sampled_law_rounds 1154, rows 9225; decode median 47.8 -> 51.7 tok/s (+8.1%), per-question median ratio 1.134
gpu_ab.ast: off vs on: 100/100 identical predictions and completion tokens; accuracy 0.49 both; batched rounds 295 (rows 295, the non-tree rounds only: tree rounds already batch). Acceptance 5.61 -> 7.23 and decode 50.2 -> 60.3 tok/s are NOT attributable to the switch: the adaptive tree-tile budget chooser picked different budgets (off: budget 3/5 in 564 of 1322 rounds; on: one 940 ms outlier sample at budget 3 locked it to 15). Confound recorded as a follow-up.
